profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that develops autonomous driving technology. Its own site describes it as a commercial-stage global company working on driving automation from Level 2 through Level 4, built around a platform it calls WeRide One, along with a self-developed foundational toolchain and what it describes as an industry-leading accumulation of real-world operational data. The company says its business footprint spans more than 60 cities across 13 countries and that it offers a portfolio of five core products, including Robotaxi.

WeRide trades on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800. It is registered with the US Securities and Exchange Commission under CIK 0001867729. The company states that it has been recognized on Fortune's 2026 Change the World list and its 2025 Future 50 list.

No litigation is recorded against the company in the material reviewed here.
